name: MODO DRUM
help: MODO DRUM factory map: L/R snare and toms, rimshots on hard hits, tight hats on ghost notes. In Natural feel also cymbal chokes at Breaks and the Ending, shank hats on accents, extra-open hats and the ride bell at Energy 4, foot splashes, cross-stick at low Energy, pedal hats, flams, open-hat barks, alternating crashes, china and ride 2. To enable the sloshy hats, set the hi-hat aperture CC number in MODO's Preferences and as hatApertureCC in this file; leave the Snare / Toms Hit Position CCs disabled (enabling them makes all snare keys identical and removes rimshots). Applies on Drums.
